notes: A cleaner HUD (the new default): one slim bar for the time, day and coins, one slim goal line, the day's notes as a row of icons you can point at or click, and your bait as a small count. Windows like the shop now stand alone with no HUD behind them.
Sharper picture: interface sizes from about 85% up on a 1080p screen, and the fishing camera's zoom, now draw with crisp hard pixels instead of a soft stretch.
The Trading Post is laid out as a shelf of cards, with the one you point at told in full on the right (a rod's range and arc, how much bait you have) and one big button to buy it.

The hatchery pond is alive: the fish wander, rest, keep out of each other's way and flick their tails, fry dart in the reeds, rings spread where a fish touches the surface, and fireflies come out after dark.

The garden tab shows each bed as its own little picture, with drops for thirsty beds and twinkles for ready ones. New: sunflowers in bloom bring bees (an extra crop for the beds beside them), a rain barrel that waters dry beds for you, planting every empty bed at once, and Sell all for your produce.

The slope under the cabin is now two terraced lawns: the garden behind a fieldstone wall with flowers, stepping stones from the door, the pond and a compost bin on the lower lawn, steps down to the stone arch, and little lamps that glow at night.
